1. [disputed] [Pre-existing] Negative rounding carry is added to the signed whole before abs()
   证据：src/dnum.ts:206 `    abs(whole),`
   abs() runs after the carry but whole is signed: -1.99 at 0 digits computes -1+1=0, so toParts returns [0n,null] and format prints '-0' instead of '-2'. Apply abs() before the carry.
   发现者：correctness；voter：uncertain — voter 未返回该 finding 的结论

2. [disputed] [Important] Hardcoded sign bypasses locale-specific minus/plus characters
   证据：src/formatting.ts:41 `  ) + BigInt(whole).toLocaleString(locale, {`
   Hardcoded '-'/'+' bypass locale signs: sv/fi/nb use U+2212 and RTL locales need bidi marks. For nonzero wholes the old toLocaleString(locale) emitted the localized minus, so these locales regress.
   发现者：correctness；voter：uncertain — voter 未返回该 finding 的结论
